headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 10, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, led by Randy Arozarena's strong performance. The Los Angeles Dodgers dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 12-3, while the Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Boston Red Sox in a close finish. The Detroit Tigers routed the Minnesota Twins 10-4, and the New York Yankees took down the Cleveland Guardians 8-4.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. The Pittsburgh Pirates placed CF Oneil Cruz on the 10-day injured list due to left hand fourth and fifth metacarpal non-displaced fractures. The Los Angeles Angels have placed C Sebastián Rivero on the 10-day injured list with a left hamate fracture and transferred RHP Jack Kochanowicz from the 15-day to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Other notable injuries include Kyle Isbel (Kansas City Royals) with left plantar fasciitis, Matt Brash (Seattle Mariners) with a right lat strain, Tyler Gilbert (Chicago White Sox) with left shoulder impingement, Ronald Acuña Jr. (Atlanta Braves) with a strained left hamstring, and Tyler Kinley (Atlanta Braves) with right elbow inflammation.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place in the past few days. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP Carson Fulmer to the Seattle Mariners for cash, while the Tampa Bay Rays traded 2B Raynel Delgado to the Houston Astros for cash. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded RHP Taylor Rashi to the Minnesota Twins for cash, and the Texas Rangers traded SS Richie Martin Jr. to the Colorado Rockies for cash.

top_news.title: **Mariners Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners edged out the Baltimore Orioles in a close game, securing a 6-5 win. Randy Arozarena led the Mariners' offense with a strong performance, collecting 3 hits, including a home run, and driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Dominate Pirates in 12-3 Rout**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured a convincing 12-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, behind a strong team effort. Andy Pages led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Red Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Nick Martinez earning the win. Marcelo Mayer led the Red Sox offense with a double and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Twins 10-4**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 10-4 victory. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with four hits, including two home runs and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Red Sox 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox in their recent matchup. Drew Rasmussen led the Rays' pitching effort, while Ceddanne Rafaela and Caleb Durbin stood out for the Red Sox.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians 8-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Carlos Rodón leading the way on the mound. Impact hitters for the Guardians included Paul Goldschmidt, Trent Grisham, José Caballero, Angel Martínez, and Austin Hedges.

top_news.title: **Pirates' Oneil Cruz Sidelined with Hand Injuries**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates center fielder Oneil Cruz has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to non-displaced fractures in his left hand's fourth and fifth metacarpal bones. The injury occurred on June 8, 2026.

top_news.title: **Pirates Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have made a trade, sending RHP Carson Fulmer to the Seattle Mariners in exchange for cash.
